column5: RULES=If you bought a card during your last Ascend, this Attack may be declared as Mid instead.
RULES=On Hit, choose one matching Armor or Gear card on the target. It provides 2 less DEF until end of turn.
RULES=If the defender plays a Defense card, this Attack gets +1 Attack Power after Defense is built.
RULES=If you played a Defense since your last turn, this Attack gets +1 Attack Power.
RULES=If you spent Focus on a card earlier this turn, gain 1 Focus after this resolves.
RULES=If you completed a Belt Exam task this round, this Attack gets +2 Attack Power. If it is your first normal Attack this turn and it Hits, gain 1 Focus.
RULES=If you Blocked since your last turn, this Attack gets +1 Attack Power.
RULES=On Hit, choose one: the target's next Item this round costs 1 more Focus; or the target's next Defense this round gets −1 Guard.
RULES=Reaction — after a Mid or Low Attack targeting you resolves, you may play this card against that attacker. If played this way, it gets +1 Attack Power.
RULES=If you Blocked an Attack this round, this Attack gets +2 Attack Power.
RULES=On Hit, choose one: the target loses Tempo for this round; or gain 1 Focus.
RULES=For Combo requirements, this card counts as two consecutive Punch steps. It awards normal Attack XP only once.

RULES=Choose High, Mid, or Low when declared. If the defender commits a Defense that would Block this Attack, you may discard 1 card to change this Attack to one of the other two zones before Defense resolves.
RULES=If a non-Honor Scene Change occurred this round, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card after this resolves.
RULES=Choose its zone when declared. If you played a Jump or Spin Attack earlier this turn, draw 1 card after this resolves.
RULES=If this is your first Attack this turn, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
RULES=On Hit, the target's matching Armor provides 1 less DEF against your next Attack this turn.
RULES=If your previous Attack this turn was Blocked, this Attack gets +2 Attack Power.
RULES=On Hit, choose one matching Armor or Gear card on the target. It provides 1 less DEF until end of turn.
RULES=If the defender plays no Defense card, this Attack gets +2 Attack Power.
RULES=If you generated at least 5 Focus this turn, this Attack gets +1 Attack Power.
RULES=On Hit, gain 1 Focus. Once per turn.
RULES=If the card you played immediately before this was a Kata or Item, this Attack gets +1 Attack Power. If it Hits after you played an Item, the target gets −1 Speed until the next Honor Phase.
RULES=After you declare a zone but before a Defense card is played, you may change this Attack to a different zone.
RULES=If this is your only Attack this turn, it gets +2 Attack Power.
RULES=If your previous Attack this turn Hit, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card after this resolves.
RULES=You may discard 1 card as an additional cost. If you do, this Attack gets +2 Attack Power.
RULES=When you play this Attack, declare High, Mid, or Low for it. If it is the third different zone you have attacked while working on your Yellow Belt Exam, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
RULES=If this completes a requirement of your active Belt Exam, gain 1 Focus after it resolves.
RULES=On Hit, choose one: gain 1 Focus; or draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
RULES=If this Attack targets a different zone than your previous Attack this turn, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
